_comment: Gate replay 7 (M5): clock-domain anchor falsification (integration-readiness section 3; game-two r2 mail measured ~800 frames/s LINEAR drift on the integration machine, tick clock ~1.7% fast). The harness 'clock' block advances the noDevice engine 400 frames/tick against tick_frames=800 - a deliberately brutal, fully deterministic skew so the tick-domain and clock-domain bar grids diverge by a full bar inside a cheap render (the real device rate is ~13 frames/tick; same mechanism, longer horizon). Mechanics WITH the anchor: at tick 130 the music request reads the engine clock (the one pinned recurring anchor point), sees drift -52000 (predicted 104000 vs actual 52000, |drift| > one tick), re-anchors to (130, 52000) and quantizes from the REAL clock -> boundary 96000, crossfade 96000..105600. COUNTERFACTUAL (pre-anchor code): predicted frame 104000 -> earliest 104800 -> boundary 192000, a full bar later - the goertzel window at [108000,120000) would still read 400 Hz (falsified live during development). Second request at tick 280 re-anchors again (predicted 172000 vs actual 112000, drift -60000) -> boundary 192000, crossfade 192000..201600, proving the anchor keeps absorbing a LINEAR rate (the boot-anchor-only design cannot). Log md5 pins the exact re-anchored schedule values forever.
name: replay_clock_drift

goertzel._calm_before: stem_a only, well before the first boundary

goertzel._the_anchor_assertion: crossfade done at 105600 on the RE-ANCHORED clock; without the re-anchor the transition sits at 192000 and this window still reads 400 Hz

goertzel._second_transition: back to calm; crossfade 192000..201600 under the SECOND re-anchor (linear drift keeps accruing after the first)

peak._comment: headroom policy: whole render under -1 dBFS sample peak
